about.title: 一家面向实用深科技的新西兰公司。
about.intro: 我们融合人工智能、数据、软件与工程，创造负责任且具有现实价值的技术。
about.storyTitle: 从复杂理念到实用系统。
storyParagraphs: IndustrialOrigami.AI was established to bridge advanced research and practical commercial technology.
The company is developing an intelligent robotic hand while building wider capability in agentic and generative AI, data science, software engineering, CAD and intelligent automation.
Our method is evidence-led: understand the problem, build a focused prototype, measure performance, learn from users and scale only when the technical and commercial case is credible.

items.title: 智能体 AI、生成式 AI、RAG 与 LLM 系统
items.menuDescription: 智能体工作流、来源支撑型 RAG、LLM、多模态问答和智能自动化。
items.summary: Production-oriented AI systems combining LLMs, retrieval, tools, memory and governed agent workflows for real business tasks.
overview: Modern AI systems can move beyond single-turn chat toward agents that plan, use tools, retrieve evidence, coordinate specialised steps and maintain state across multi-step work.

We design grounded retrieval and controlled action pathways using hybrid search, reranking, citations, structured outputs, tool and API integration, memory, multimodal inputs, human approval and access controls.
Architectures can support interoperable tool and context connections, specialist-agent collaboration, tracing, automated evaluation and human review before wider deployment.
capabilities: RAG with hybrid retrieval, reranking and citations
Tool/function calling, APIs and MCP-ready connectivity
Evaluation, tracing, guardrails and human approval

items.title: 智能机器人手
items.menuDescription: Sensing, edge AI and deterministic control for adaptive manipulation.
items.statusDescription: The concept and system architecture are being developed through staged technical and commercial validation.
items.summary: A modular robotic hand and forearm platform combining mechanical engineering, sensing, real-time control, computer vision and edge AI.
overview: Conventional industrial grippers perform well for repetitive tasks and predictable objects but may be less useful when shape, orientation, fragility or material changes.
The project investigates whether a modular, force-aware and vision-guided hand can provide useful flexibility without becoming impractically complex or expensive.
Development can be validated incrementally at finger, thumb, palm and integrated-hand level before committing to a complete system.
technology: Force, current, position and tactile sensing

roadmap.title: Mechanism validation
roadmap.description: Validate linkage, force, actuation, sensing, control and safety.

roadmap.title: Integrated hand
roadmap.description: Combine multiple digits, perception, planning and industrial communication.

roadmap.title: Industry pilot
roadmap.description: Test a narrow application and quantify performance, cost and value.

items.title: 工业智能体 AI 平台
items.menuDescription: A governed platform combining agents, GenAI, RAG, LLMs, tools and source-grounded QA.
items.statusDescription: The platform is presented as a structured prototype and future service concept rather than a completed customer deployment.
items.summary: A multilingual industrial AI platform combining source-grounded knowledge retrieval with agentic workflows, tool use, multimodal interaction and evaluated LLM responses.
overview: Industrial organisations often store valuable knowledge across manuals, policies, reports, specifications, databases and project systems.

The platform combines modern RAG with hybrid retrieval, reranking and citations, then adds agent orchestration so specialised workflows can use tools, call APIs and preserve useful state across multi-step work.
The architecture is designed for responsible deployment with access controls, structured outputs, human approval where needed, tracing, feedback and evaluation.
technology: FastAPI or Node.js AI and tool services
PostgreSQL with pgvector or equivalent vector storage
Hybrid retrieval, metadata filters and reranking
Agent orchestration, tool calling and MCP-ready integrations
Tracing, evaluation, guardrails and source citation
value: Faster access to approved technical knowledge
More transparent answers with citations and evaluation
Reusable platform for internal and customer-facing AI
A controlled path from assistants to production agents

roadmap.title: Knowledge foundation
roadmap.description: Build ingestion, metadata, hybrid retrieval, reranking, permissions and source-aware QA.

roadmap.title: Agentic workflows
roadmap.description: Add specialised agents, tool and API use, memory, multimodal inputs and approval points.

roadmap.title: Production evaluation
roadmap.description: Add traces, automated and human evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, cost controls and deployment governance.

items.title: 预测性维护
items.menuDescription: Machine-learning signals for equipment risk and maintenance planning.
items.statusDescription: The project requires a suitable equipment dataset and industry partner before performance claims can be made.
items.summary: A data and machine-learning system for identifying abnormal equipment behaviour and supporting maintenance decisions.
overview: Unplanned equipment failure can create downtime, cost and safety risk, but useful prediction depends on data quality and a clearly defined failure or degradation signal.
The project demonstrates how sensor histories, maintenance records and operational context can be prepared, modelled and monitored.
The system compares practical baselines with more advanced methods rather than assuming that a complex model is automatically better.

roadmap.title: Data and failure definition
roadmap.description: Assess sensor coverage, labels, maintenance history and business value.

roadmap.title: Model and dashboard
roadmap.description: Develop baselines, evaluation and operational visualisation.

roadmap.title: Pilot monitoring
roadmap.description: Validate alerts, drift, false positives and maintenance usefulness.

items.title: 工程 CAD
items.menuDescription: 3D mechanical design, assemblies, drawings and design-for-manufacture using Autodesk Inventor and SolidWorks.
items.statusDescription: CAD capability supports robotic mechanisms and prototype development, with models refined as engineering requirements and manufacturing constraints are validated.
items.summary: Parametric 3D CAD for mechanical parts and assemblies, from concept geometry to manufacturing drawings and iterative prototype development.
overview: Engineering CAD converts functional requirements into controlled 3D parts, assemblies and drawings that can be reviewed, manufactured and revised.
The workflow can cover robotic mechanisms, linkages, housings, brackets, fixtures and other engineered components using Autodesk Inventor and SolidWorks.
Design reviews consider fit, motion, tolerances, interfaces, materials, fasteners, serviceability and manufacturability before physical prototyping.
value: Clearer communication between engineering and manufacturing
Reusable design history and controlled revisions
A stronger path from concept to physical prototype

roadmap.title: Requirements and concept
roadmap.description: Define interfaces, motion, loads, dimensions, materials and an initial parametric concept.

roadmap.title: Detailed assembly
roadmap.description: Develop parts and assemblies, run fit and interference checks, and prepare manufacturing documentation.

roadmap.title: Prototype and validation
roadmap.description: Fabricate or print selected parts, test the mechanism, capture issues and feed measured results back into the CAD model.
